adp.title: Ad platforms
adp.sub: Your ad accounts as Facebook and Instagram see them: the campaigns and ad sets, read from the platform. Read only — nothing is paused and no budget changes here.

mode.MOCK: Practice copy — nothing is read from the platform

adp.readDone: {campaigns} campaigns and {adSets} ad sets read; {gone} no longer listed by the platform.
adp.readPractice: Practice copy: {campaigns} example campaigns read, nothing saved. Type the key on Keys & connections to read your real account.
adp.practiceH: Example from the practice copy (not saved)
adp.noAccount: Nothing read yet. Press "Read now" after the key is in.
adp.noManage: You can see this page; reading and tying need the "Change campaigns" permission.
adp.readOnlyNote: Pausing a campaign or changing a budget comes from the dashboard later, always behind your confirm (an increase needs your approval).

err.INVALID_INPUT: Something in it is not right.
err.NOT_FOUND: It is not there any more; the page was read again.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
err.unauthorized: Your sign-in ran out. Sign in again.
err.other: It did not work. Try again.
err.STALE: Someone changed this card in between; it was read again.

spend.importDone: {rows} campaign days of spend kept ({from} to {to}).
spend.importPractice: Practice copy: {rows} example days counted, nothing saved.
spend.importUnknown: {unknown} days of campaigns the platform did not list were left out.
spend.importNoRate: {noRate} days in another currency wait for the USD rate.
spend.spendNote: Spend is read per campaign and per day and kept for the profit figures (Money › Profit and loss, channels, each order). Reading again replaces each day, it never adds twice.

card.d: Off as it ships. "Import spend now" works with it off too.
card.onHelp: Once a day from your hour (store time) the shop reads what each platform spent per campaign. Read only: no budget or campaign changes.
card.daysHelp: Today included. The platforms correct the last few days for a while, so they are read again and replaced (1 to 30).
card.hourHelp: The hour of the store’s day (0 to 23) from which the daily import runs.
card.readOnly: You can see this card; changing it needs the "Change campaigns" permission.

spend.rateLine: Dollar rate: 1 {base} = {rate} (from {when}). Spend in {base} is turned into {store} with the rate of its day.
spend.rateNone: No {base} rate yet: spend in {base} is kept but not in the profit figures until you type the rate.
spend.rateLink: Change the rate on Money › Costs & fees

alerts.d: The last {days} days ({from} to {to}): what the ads cost for each order placed and each order delivered. Orders count on the day placed, delivered ones on the day delivered, returned ones on the day they came back.
alerts.unknownNote: Some spend is in another currency with no dollar rate for its day yet, so it is not counted as zero: type the rate on Money › Costs & fees.
alerts.noFigures: No ad spend and no order from an ad in these days yet.
alerts.rulesD: Each rule is off when you add it. A rule that is on is checked after each daily spend import and sent to your Telegram when crossed (switch "Send alerts" below). An alert never pauses a campaign or changes a budget.

card.d: Off as it ships. The table and each rule's state above show with it off too.
card.onHelp: Right after each daily spend import (Daily spend import card), the rules that are on and crossed go to your Telegram in one message.
card.daysHelp: Today included (1 to 90). Delivered parcels take a few days, so a week or more reads better.
card.readOnly: You can see this card; changing it needs the "Change campaigns" permission.

tg.head: Ad cost alert ({from} to {to}):
tg.noOrders: {where}: {metric} — spent {spend} and nothing counted yet, over your limit {limit}
tg.foot: Nothing was paused or changed. See Marketing › Ad platforms.

control.d: Pausing or lowering a daily budget is sent after you confirm. Starting again or raising a budget waits for the owner's approval and nothing changes until he approves. Until a platform is connected for changes every change goes to its practice copy: nothing reaches the platform.

confirm.resume: Ask the owner to start “{name}” again? Nothing changes until he approves.
confirm.down: Lower the daily budget of “{name}” from {from} to {to}? It is sent now.
confirm.up: Ask the owner to raise the daily budget of “{name}” from {from} to {to}? Nothing changes until he approves.

said.PRACTICE: Sent to the practice copy: nothing reached the platform.
said.FAILED: The platform refused it; nothing changed.

err.WAITING: A request for this campaign already waits for the owner.

control.confirmApprove: Approve: {what}? It is sent at once.
control.noControl: Changing a campaign needs the "Control ads" permission.

card.d: Off as it ships. Only the owner can switch it.
card.onHelp: On, each platform campaign gets a "Change" fold. Pausing and lowering a budget are sent after a confirm; starting again and raising a budget wait for your approval.
card.hours: Hours an increase waits for approval
card.hoursHelp: 1 to 720. After that the request runs out and nothing changes.
card.readOnly: You can see this card; changing it needs the "Approve ad budget increases" permission.

growth.title: Growth agent
growth.sub: Tirondaj reads what the ads brought back in delivered parcels and proposes changes. Nothing changes until you approve.
growth.note: The agent only proposes. A pause or a budget change you approve goes through the campaign controls (they must be on) and, until a platform is connected for changes, only to its practice copy.
growth.waitingNone: Nothing waits. With every limit at 0 the agent proposes nothing.

type.lowerBudget: Lower the daily budget of “{name}” from {from} to {to}
type.raiseBudget: Raise the daily budget of “{name}” from {from} to {to}

why.pause: Spent {spend} in {from} – {to} and not one order was delivered.
why.lowerBudget: Delivered ROAS {roas} (your floor {limit}) on {delivered} delivered orders.
why.raiseBudget: Delivered ROAS {roas} (your bar {limit}) on {delivered} delivered orders.
why.buildAudience: {sales} of delivered sales, ROAS {roas}: people like these buyers are worth reaching.

growth.confirmApprove: Approve: {what}? A pause or a budget change is sent at once.

said.APPROVED: Approved and kept: make it from Marketing › Audiences or the creative brief.
said.PRACTICE: Sent to the practice copy: nothing reached the platform.
said.FAILED: The platform refused it; nothing changed.

err.CONTROL_OFF: Turn on the campaign controls on Ad platforms first; nothing was decided.
err.CHANGED: The campaign changed since the proposal; approved, but nothing was sent.
err.WAITING: Another change for this campaign waits for approval.

growth.flagD: Campaigns that spent in {from} – {to} without one delivered order. Shown whatever your limits.
growth.flagNone: None — every campaign that spent has delivered orders.
growth.roasD: Delivered sales ÷ ad spend, {from} – {to} (your last {days} days). 300 % = 3 taka back for each taka spent. A product's or district's spend is its share of its campaigns' spend.
growth.noFigures: No ad spend or delivered ad order in these days yet.

card.d: Every limit at 0 keeps that kind of proposal off. Only the owner changes these.
card.readOnly: Only the owner (approve ad budget increases) changes the limits.
card.on: Run every day after the spend import
card.onHelp: Off: only “Run now”. The agent never changes anything by itself.
card.daysHelp: Today included; the same number of days before them is the comparison for a tired creative.
card.minDeliveredHelp: A campaign, product or district needs this many delivered orders before its ROAS is judged.
card.goodRoasPercent: Good ROAS (%) — raise budget / build audience
card.goodRoasPercentHelp: At or over this, the agent proposes a higher daily budget and an audience. 0 = off.
card.poorRoasPercentHelp: Under this, the agent proposes a lower daily budget. 0 = off.
card.stepPercentHelp: How much a proposal raises or lowers a daily budget.
card.noDeliveredSpend: Pause after this spend with no delivered order
card.noDeliveredSpendHelp: In whole {currency}. Over it with not one delivered order, the agent proposes a pause. 0 = off.
card.fatiguePercentHelp: ROAS fallen by more than this against the days before → refresh the creative. 0 = off.
card.approvalHoursHelp: Not decided by then, it runs out and nothing changes.
card.maxProposalsHelp: The most urgent come first: pause, lower, refresh, raise, audience.

brief.title: Creative briefs
brief.sub: Tirondaj writes the brief for the studio from a product and its offer: formats, hooks in both languages, what the picture shows and where the ad leads.
brief.note: A brief is words for the studio only. It never changes a price, a budget or a campaign. Correct the words, then send it.
brief.off: Briefs are off. Switch them on in the card at the bottom of this page.
brief.newD: Pick a product and, if you like, the platform campaign it is for. The brief is written from the product's price, colours and page.
brief.wrote: The brief is written; it is at the top of the list.
brief.noWrite: Writing a brief needs the “edit campaigns” permission.
brief.refreshD: The growth agent proposed a new creative for these campaigns and you approved it. Write a brief for each.
brief.refreshNone: No approved creative refresh is waiting for a brief.
brief.figuresNone: No delivered order from the ads yet.
brief.confirmSend: Send this brief to the studio? It can no longer be corrected after that.
brief.confirmSetAside: Set this brief aside? It stays in the list.

err.OFF: Briefs are off; switch them on in the card below.
err.TAKEN: This proposal already has its brief.
err.DECIDED: This brief was already sent or set aside; the page was read again.

card.d: Off as it ships. The formats and numbers every new brief asks for.
card.readOnly: Only someone with the “control ads” permission changes these.
card.onHelp: Off as it ships. Off, the page only lists the kept briefs.
card.carouselHelp: A carousel of the product's colours.
card.videoHelp: A video for stories and reels.
card.noTextOnPictureHelp: The brief asks for a clean picture; the platform adds the text.
card.optimiseForHelp: Delivered purchase uses the shop's delivered event, so the platform learns from parcels that arrived.

tpl.show: The {name} worn and laid flat, every colour side by side, on the house background.
tpl.noText: No words baked into the picture.
